integrity: The law and sharp support are proved analytically; accompanying standard-library checkers are corroborating finite checks only. No independent validation is claimed.
limitations: Only central Haar-oriented planar sections of the 3-dimensional Euclidean cube are treated.
The conditional distribution is a specified continuous regular version at measure-zero conditioning values.
The full motivating 2026 paper could not be inspected, so priority against unexamined appendices or older formulas remains at risk.
title: Conditional diameter law and sharp two-radius phase diagram for central cube sections
